title: PATMT2: Two-stage domain adaptation for multilingual patent translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present PatMT2 (Patent Machine Translation, v2), a two-stage LoRA pipeline that adapts the Hy-MT2-7B dedicated translation model to four-language (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) patent translation. On six translation directions, the Stage-2 checkpoint reaches a macro-average BLEU of 43.39 (BF16) to 43.57 (AWQ INT4), improving over the Hy-MT2-7B base by up to +8.8 BLEU and also exceeding Qwen3-32B and several external systems on the same average. We then measure the cost of adaptation: probing 38 languages absent from the fine-tuning data, the model still produces correct, fluent output on 34, while four low-resource languages collapse into distinct, reproducible failure modes. We treat these as diagnostic cases rather than retention rates, and report their mechanisms without attributing them to a single cause. Paired bootstrap tests confirm the translation gains over all baselines (p < 0.001).

translated_title: PATMT2：面向多语言专利翻译的两阶段领域自适应
translated_abstract: 我们提出PatMT2（专利机器翻译v2），这是一个两阶段LoRA流水线，将Hy-MT2-7B专用翻译模型适配至中/英/日/韩四种语言的专利翻译任务。在六个翻译方向上，第二阶段检查点达到43.39（BF16）至43.57（AWQ INT4）的宏平均BLEU，相比Hy-MT2-7B基础模型最高提升+8.8 BLEU，并在相同平均值上超越Qwen3-32B及多个外部系统。随后我们测量了领域适配的代价：在微调数据未涵盖的38种语言上进行探测，模型仍能在其中34种语言上产生正确、流畅的输出，而四种低资源语言则崩溃为不同的、可复现的失败模式。我们将这些视为诊断案例而非保留率，并报告其机制，而不将其归因于单一原因。配对自助法检验证实了相对于所有基线的翻译提升（p < 0.001）。
tldr: 提出两阶段LoRA流水线PatMT2，将Hy-MT2-7B适配为中英日韩专利翻译模型，宏平均BLEU最高达43.57、较基础模型提升最多8.8分，并系统分析了领域适配对38种未微调语言的影响与失效机制。
en_tdlr: PatMT2 presents a two-stage LoRA pipeline adapting Hy-MT2-7B for Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean patent translation, achieving up to +8.8 BLEU gain (macro-average 43.57) over the base model, while also characterizing the cost of adaptation across 38 non-fine-tuned languages.
